2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up t o 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, contract qua ntity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the r evised quantity or duration 2. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consen t of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respe ct of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wage s of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payme nt from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank state ment of payment done to staff. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work (SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK & NATURE OF DUTIES OF SECURITY GUARDS(WITHOUT ARMS): Two Security Personnel shall be required to guard the entire office building and Quarters at Income Tax Office, Aayakar Bhawan, Palakol, round the clock on all days and on 24x7 basis in shifts (D ay and Night). Thus, both the Security Guards shall be required to work as Night Watchman also wh en their turn comes i n roster. They will be responsible for guarding assets and property inside the o ffice building and Quarters buildings as well as the open courtyard in front and back of the building. However, no Security Guard shall l eave place of duty before arrival of Security Guard of next shift. I n other words, at no time the place of duty of Security Guard cum Night Watchman shall lie deserte d and empty. Security personnel should maintain strict security of the men, material and premises. They will be responsible for thefts of easily movable items like official records, furniture items, com puters, bathroom fittings, fans, telephone instruments etc. Alert the staff on duty in case of fire and assist in fire fighting operations if necessary. Security personnel should conduct themselves in a fit manner before distinguished visitors, VIPs and Officers of the department. Security personnel shall maintain register for incoming/outgoing persons into the office premises. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer added Additional terms and conditions of providing Security Personnel shall be a s under: 1. Service and Support: An office of the service provider must be located in the state of consi gnee. Documentary evidence regarding the same should be submitted. 2. Successful bidder can submit the Performance security in the form of Account Payee Dema nd Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be in favour of Zonal Accco unts Officer, CBDT, Visakhapatnam. After award of contract, Successful bidder can upload the scann ed copy of DD in pl ace of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original DD to the buyer w ithin 15 Days of award of Contract. 3. Service provider shall ensure that the invoice is raised in the name of INCOME TAX OFFICE R, WARD-1, PALAKOL. While generating invoice on GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy screen shot of confirmation of GST payment. 4. Payment of salaries and wages: Service provider is required to pay salaries/wages of contr acted staff deployed at buyer location from their own resources first and then claim payment from B uyer organization along with copy of payment of statutory documents like PF, ESI etc as well as ban k statement of payment done to the contracted staff. Payment of wages by Service Provider to outs ourced persons shall not be condition precedent or linked with payment of bills by Purchaser or Inco me Tax department. Bidder will have to give an undertaking in this regard stating his ability to pay from own resources before receiving payment of bill from Purchaser. 5. The bidder should not be in liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings , should

not be bankrupt. Bidders should upload undertaking to this effect with the bid. 6. Bidders are advised to check the applicable GST before quoting. 7. Bidders offer is liable to be rejected if they do not upload any of the certificates/Test report s sought in the bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. The bidders should have experience of at least 3 years in similar nature of work. The bidde r agencies should not be black listed by any Government or Semi Government or any other organiz ation. 9. The Service Provider /bidder should have valid GST registration, PF, ESI, CST/VAT/TIN, TAN, trade tax registration, labour department registration and PAN. Necessary documents in this regard must be uploaded. 10. Preference shall be given to the person(s) who have past experience of working in any offi ce of the Income Tax Department. Next preference shall be given to person(s) who have past experi ence of working in any other office of the Central Government or the State Government. Decision of the Purchaser shall be final in this matter. 11. Preference shall be given to those who have PSARA Certificate issued by Andhra Pradesh s tate Government. 7. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 8. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Nu mbers for Service Support. 9. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 10. Purchase Preference (State) Bid reserved for MSE from the State of Bid Inviting Authority: Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Micro and Small Enterprises from the State of Bid Inviting Authority havi ng valid Udyam Registration and whose credentials are validated online through Udyam Registration portal. If the bidder wants to avail themselves of the reservation benefit, the bidder mu st be the manufacturer / OEM of the offered product on GeM. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises and hence resellers offering products manufactured by some other OEM are not eligible to participate in this bid. In respect of bid for Serv ices, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidenc e in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service, an d Buyer will decide eligibility based on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. B enefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated an d approved by Buyer after evaluation of documents submitted. 11. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed. b. Execution certif icate by client with contract value. c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Th ird Party Inspection release note, etc. Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as v alid proof for meeting the experience criteria a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self- certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed b. Execution certificate by client with contract value. c. Any other document in support of cont ract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s)

Text Clause(s) Service Level Additional Terms and Conditions: (SLA) The service Provider on its part and through its resources shall ensure that 1. No Unauthorized Person(s) gain entry in the office premises and observe regulations for entry/exit from the office gate No theft or pilferage takes place in any of the property of the office building. 2. To take all necessary steps to safe guard and protect the property of the Department and take in the int erest maintaining proper security of office with due care and diligence. 3. To give such reports relating to Security matters at such frequency as may be demanded by the Depart ment. 4. To provide complete security round the clock by changing the duty hours of the personnel in rotation of replacement subject to statutory Limitations. 5. The Service Provider shall be responsible for all acts of Commission and omission on the part of its secur ity Staff and will take such preventive measure and precautions as may be deemed necessary for the Safet y of the property / material List contained in the office premises. 6. The service Provider will be Wholly and exclusively responsible for payment of wages to the persons en gaged by it and compliance of all statutory obligations on its respect of all payments of wages Act, 1936, Minimum Wages Act,1948,EmployeesProvident funds and Miscellaneous provisions Act, 1952, ESI Act ,194 8, Workmen’s Compensation Act, 1923, and all other related Legislation as applicable and Department shal l not incur any liability or additional expenditure whatsoever for the persons employer by the service provi der on account of the above mentioned obligations. 7. All Security Personnel should be provided by the Service Provider With proper uniform, including headg ear, boots, shoes, Whistle, lathies and other material required for the smart turn out and efficient performa nce of the duties. 8. The service Provider shall ensure that the persons deputed by are medically fit. 9. It is clearly understood that the persons employed by the Service Provider shall not be deemed to the e mployees of the Department and shall have no relationship of Employer/ Employees or Master / Servant wi th the Department. 10. The Department shall not be Liable to any claim for damages or compensation that might become pay able to the employees of Service Provider in the event of an accident resulting in any possible injury or de ath of any employee of the service provider while performing their duty within/outside the premises referred to above or damage of any other kind. The Service Provider shall always keep the Department full y indemnified against any such claim or damage. 11. The persons deputed by the service Provider shall not interfere with the duties of the employees of the department. 12. The service provider should replace the security personnel within 48 hours as and when the Departme nt makes any oral/written complaint about any of the named persons. 13. The Service Provider should pay the minimum rates of wages to the security personnel supplied to the Department and should disburse salaries/wages of contracted staff deployed at office location from their o wn sources first and then claim payment from the department along with statutory documents like P F, ESI etc as well as bank statement of payment done to the contracted staff. 14. The Security personnel deployed by the service provider to serve the department as per the agreemen t shall while on duty take the necessary instructions from the authorized person by the service provider. 15. The service provider is responsible for the recovery of the property lost by the department or it shall r eimburse full amount of loss of pilferage caused directly or indirectly without connivance of the security pe rsonnel. 16. If department suffers any loss or damage on account of negligence, default or theft on part of any of th e employees/agents of the service provider, then the service provider shall keep the department fully inde mnified against against such loss or damage. 17. The service provider shall observe all laws, rules, regulations, orders and directions issued by the conc

erning for discharge of duties. Any contravention of such laws, rules, regulations, order and directions will be deemed to be breach of contract and the service provider shall be liable for all such consequence and i s case of any such breach, if the department incurs any obligations then the service provider shall be resp onsible to reimburse the department any loss monetary or otherwise occasioned on account of such breac h or contravention. 18. The service provider shall ensure and guarantee the behaviour and honesty of the personnel deputed by it. In case of any misconduct or any other damage or theft to the property of the department the servic e provider shall be responsible for such losses or damages. The personnel of the service provider shall be l iable to be searched at the gate. 19. The service provider shall not assign, transfer, charge, hypothecate or in any manner make over the c ontract to any other agency without the consent of the department in writing. 20. The Service provider shall not disclose any information concerning the affairs of the department which may have come to its knowledge without the consent of the department in writing. The service provider an d personnel deputed by it must sign appropriate confidentiality agreement/Non-disclosure agreement to p rotect confidential and sensitive information of the department. 21. The Service provider will submit its bills/invoices through GeM portal every month and the same will be paid following due procedure in GeM having full filled satisfaction of the department its obligation under th e contract. The department however reserves the right to make such deductions out of its expenses incurr ed by the department on behalf of the service provider for nonperformance of its part of the contract. 22. The contract will commence from 01-01-2027 to 31-12-2027 for a period of Two Years. However, th e contract can be terminated by either party on giving one month notice in advance. 23. If service provider commits breach of any conditions of contract or fails to fulfill its obligations, the dep artment shall be at liberty to terminate the contract without any notice. 24. The Contract shall be valid for a period of Two Years commencing from the date of signing of such agre ement and shall continue to be in force in the same manner unless terminated or modified in writing. The c ontract/agreement is renewable subject to the satisfactory performance of the service provider and with s uch amendments/modified of terms and conditions as may be mutually agreed to including rise in w ages/ service charges taking into account the increase in minimum wages by the Government of India after the c ontract comes in force. 25. The Service provider shall provide a performance security deposit 2% of the value of contract in the for m of Account Payee Demand Draft Drawn infavour of Zonal Accounts Officer, CBDT, Visakhapatnam payab le at Visakhapatnam or fixed deposit receipt from commercial bank or bank guarantee from the commerci al bank in an acceptable form of performance guarantee for safeguarding the interest of the department i n all respects. The security deposit shall remain valid for period of 60 days beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations of the service provider. The security deposit will be fortified in the event of an y violation of any of the terms and conditions of this bid by the bidder in the event of any verifiable compli ant of non-payment of minimum wages as per law. 26. On the expiry of contract as mentioned the service provider will withdraw all its personnel and clear th eir accounts by paying them all their legal dues as required under the provision of industrial disputes Act, 1947 or any other laws as applicable. 27. In case of any disputes on account of the termination of employment or non employment by the perso nnel of the service provider it shall be the entire responsible of the service provider to pay and settle the s ame. 28. The service provider shall comply with all the order/awards passed by the competent authority/court in respect of the personnel engaged by it. Both bidder and buyer can add to or delete any of the terms and c onditions with mutual consent. 29. In event of any dispute raising in respect of the clause(s) of the contract the matter will be referred to the Income Tax Officer,Ward-1, Palakol whose decision shall be binding on Service provider as well as Buyer Organization.
